# The Art of Education

> A comprehensive resource hub for K-12 art educators featuring podcasts, videos, curriculum design guidance, and professional development content.

The Art of Education (TAE) serves art teachers through multiple platforms including Art Ed Radio podcasts, instructional video archives, and the Art Ed NOW Conference. The site provides practical classroom strategies, funding resources, and professional development opportunities for visual arts educators.

## Audio & Video Learning

- [Podcast Archive - The Art of Education](https://theartofeducation.edu/podcasts): Art Ed Radio podcast archive featuring hosts discussing art education topics, instructional strategies, and professional development for art teachers.
- [Video Archive - The Art of Education](https://theartofeducation.edu/videos): Video archive with K-12 art education instructional strategies and studio practices for classroom implementation.

## Resources & Support

- [Funding & Advocacy Resources - The Art of Education](http://theartofeducation.edu/funding-advocacy): Grant funding and advocacy resources for arts education using Title funding and securing support for visual arts programs.
- [Help Center](http://help.theartofeducation.edu): Help center for FLEX Curriculum and PRO Learning product support and user guidance.
